does: Rolls a dice formula from a roll stream: seeds a 64-bit Mersenne Twister with the stream's seed, draws each die from 1 to its faces at the stream's count, adds the formula's bonus, and moves the stream's success or failure debt by the outcome against a difficulty.

evidence.says: Every hit of the draw (GK.Memory.Watch on the roll manager's count, +0x105AAE3) returns through +0x105CB3D; one passive check moves the count by two
